Corporate Profile




                                                                                                       蘇州玫瑰園
                                                                                                       Suzhou Rose Garden




綠城中國控股有限公司是中國領先的優質房產品開發及生活綜合服務供應商，以優秀的產品質
量、獨特的建築美學、以人為本的服務保持行業引領地位。公司連續二十一年榮獲「中國房地產
百強企業綜合實力Top10」1 ，所進駐重點城市客戶滿意度連續十四年保持領先，此外，綠城還憑
藉其高品質的產品連續三年榮獲產品力測評榜第一 2 ，並獲得「中國房企品牌價值Top5」
                                          「 中國房
地產高質量發展優秀企業」等榮譽。

Greentown China Holdings Limited is a leading quality property developer and an integrated living
service provider in China. It maintains a leadership position in the industry by virtue of the quality of
its properties, its unique architectural aesthetics, and its customer-centric services. The Company has
been awarded the “Top10 among 100 Chinese Real Estate Enterprises by Comprehensive Strength” 1
for 21 consecutive years and maintained a leading position in customer satisfaction in core cities in
which it operates for 14 consecutive years. Meanwhile, Greentown ranked first in the product strength
assessment lists for three consecutive years2 for its quality products as well as received honors such
as “Top5 Chinese Real Estate Companies by Brand Value” and “Outstanding Chinese Real Estate
Enterprises with High-Quality Development”.

Chairman’s Statement




董事會主席及非執行董事             Chairman of the Board and Non-Executive Director             義烏鳳起潮鳴
                                                                                     Yiwu Fengqi Chaoming
劉成雲先生                   Mr LIU Chengyun




2024年，全球經濟形勢尚未好轉，房地產行業仍處於弱勢整理階段，政策支持與市場調整並存，
挑戰與機遇同在。儘管政策端持續釋放積極信號，但市場需求收縮、預期轉弱、投資放緩的行業
特徵依然顯著。在這場行業大考中，我們以經營安全為底線，以經營最優為原則，以現金流為根
本，產品優勢更加凸顯，各項能力明顯提升，發展質量進一步提高。

In 2024, the global economic situation has not yet improved. The real estate industry is still vulnerable
and in the phase of reform. There was policy support together with market adjustment, presenting
both challenges and opportunities. Despite ongoing positive signals from the policy side, the industry
continued to present notable characteristics, including shrinking market demand, weakening
expectations and a slowdown in investments. Amid this rigorous industry challenge, we have upheld
business safety as the bottom line, optimal operational results as the principle, and cash flow as the
cornerstone, so that our product advantages have become more prominent, our capabilities have
significantly strengthened, and the development quality has further improved.

但我們也清醒認識到，行業結構性調整具有長期     However, we are also fully aware that the structural adjustment in the industry
性特徵。從影響房地產行業發展的關鍵基礎要素     is long-term in nature. From the perspective of the key fundamental elements
來看，行業縮量下行走勢在短期內不會有本質轉     influencing the development of the real estate industry, the downward trend of
變：一是人口增速自2017年以來快速下滑，市場   the industry’s shrinking scale is unlikely to see a fundamental change in the short
需求持續萎靡；二是貨幣供應鈍化，經濟預期恢     term: first, the population growth rate has declined rapidly since 2017, leading to
復仍需時間。受此大環境背景影響，房地產行業     persistently sluggish market demand; second, monetary supply has become less
新開工、開發實際到位資金以及開發投資規模等     effective, and it still takes time for the recovery of economic expectations. Under
指標數據，自2021年以來持續大幅下滑，表明行   the backdrop of this macro environment, indicators including new construction
業發展活力減弱，市場還存在巨大的不確定性，     projects, actual funds available for development, and investment scale for
在這樣的行業形勢下，確保企業經營安全仍是我     development of the real estate industry, have continued to decline sharply
們的首要任務。                   since 2021, underscoring the weakening of industry’s development vitality with
                          considerable uncertainties in the market. In such an industry condition, ensuring
                          the safety of business operations remains our top priority.


與此同時，當前房地產行業正經歷「三個根本性重    Meanwhile, the real estate industry is undergoing “Three Fundamental
構」：其一，市場格局重構，高能級城市核心地段    Restructurings”: first, the market landscape is being restructured, as core
成為價值「安全島」；其二，發展模式重構，行業    locations in high-tier cities have become the “safe islands” of value; second, the
平均淨利潤率大幅下降，「高周轉」模式逐漸走向    development model is being restructured, as the average net profit margin in
終結；其三，競爭要素重構，產品創新迭代速度     the industry has significantly declined and the “high turnover” model gradually
提升，客戶對智能家居、健康住宅等新需求的支     comes to an end; third, the competition factors are being restructured, with
付意願有所溢價。商品房建設領域將進一步落實     faster product innovation and iteration, and the willingness of customers to pay a
嚴控增量、優化存量、提高質量的發展要求。這     premium for the new demands such as smart homes, healthy housing, etc. The
些基礎性變量的改變，標志著房地產行業已經進     commercial housing construction sector will further implement the development
入「存量博弈、品質制勝」的新發展階段。       requirements of strict controls on increments, optimization of inventories and
                          improvement of quality. These changes of fundamental variables signify that the
                          real estate industry has entered a new development stage of “stock competition

經營回顧                                        Operation Review
2024年，中國房地產市場在政策驅動下呈現深度                     In 2024, driven by policies, the Chinese real estate market underwent deep
調整態勢，中央穩地產政策從鬆綁限制性到出台                       adjustments. Aiming at stabilizing the real estate market, the central government
刺激性政策不斷升級，市場呈現「政策驅動型」脈                      policies evolved from loosening restrictions to introducing stimulus policies,
衝行情，四季度重點城市新房銷售有所回暖，但                       leading to a “policy-driven” market. Sales of new properties in key cities have
區域分化加劇，三四線城市持續承壓，整體市場                       rebounded in the fourth quarter, but the regional differentiation has intensified
延續築底行情。行業規模繼續收縮，全年新建商                       with third- and fourth-tier cities continuing to face pressure, the overall market
                                            was yet bottoming out. The industry’s scale continued to shrink with the sales of
品房銷售額跌破人民幣10萬億；開發投資持續放
                                            new commercial properties falling below RMB10 trillion for the Year. Investment
緩，房屋新開工及竣工面積同比降幅均超兩成；
                                            continued to slow down, with a year-on-year decrease of over 20% in both
商品房庫存量達到歷史新高，土地成交規模延續
                                            newly constructed and completed property area. The inventory of commercial
下滑，行業融資規模持續收縮，全面止跌回穩仍
                                            properties rose to a historical high, the volume of land transactions remained on
面臨較大壓力。
                                            a downward trend, and the financing scale of the industry constantly contracted.
                                            Thus there are still significant challenges on the overall recovery and stabilization
                                            of the market.

      經濟利益行事。                         when pricing the asset or liability, assuming that market participants act in

      內可能發生的違約事件引致的預期信貸虧                                    historical credit loss experience, adjusted for factors that are specific to
      損。評估乃根據本集團過往信貸虧損經驗                                    the debtors, general economic conditions and an assessment of both the
      作出，並就應收賬款特定因素、整體經濟                                    current conditions at the reporting date as well as the forecast of future
      狀況以及對於報告日期的當時狀況及未來                                    conditions.
      狀況預測的評估作出調整。

      投資物業的遞延稅項                                           Deferred taxation on investment properties
      就計量採用公平值模式計量的投資物業產                                  For the purposes of measuring deferred tax liabilities or deferred tax assets

      消耗投資物業來實現絕大部分經濟利益的                                  under a business model whose objective is to consume substantially all of
      業務模式，而非透過銷售來實現絕大部分                                  the economic benefits embodied in the investment properties over time,
      經濟利益的業務模式。因此，於計量本集                                  rather than through sale. Therefore, in measuring the Group’s deferred
      團投資物業遞延稅項時，董事已決定，採                                  taxation on investment properties, the directors have determined that
      用公平值模式計量的投資物業的賬面值透                                  the presumption that the carrying amounts of investment properties
      過隨時間消耗投資物業來全部收回的假設                                  measured using the fair value model are recovered entirely through
      不予駁回。因此，本集團就投資物業公平                                  economic benefits embodied in the investment properties over time is
      值變動確認企業所得稅的相關遞延稅項。                                  not rebutted. As a result, the Group has recognised deferred enterprise

      未動用稅項虧損的遞延稅項                                        Deferred taxation on unused tax losses
      倘有可能錄得應課稅利潤並可用於抵銷虧                                  Deferred tax assets are recognised for unused tax losses to the extent
      損，則會就未動用稅項虧損確認遞延稅項                                  that it is probable that taxable profit will be available against which the

48.   金融風險管理目標及政策（續）            48.   Financial Risk Management Objectives and Policies
                                      (continued)
      流動資金風險                          Liquidity risk
      於管理流動資金風險時，本集團監察及維              In the management of the liquidity risk, the Group monitors and maintains
      持現金及現金等價物於管理層認為適當的              a level of cash and cash equivalents deemed adequate by management
      水平，以為本集團的營運提供資金及減輕              to finance the Group’s operations and mitigate the effects of fluctuations
      現金流量波動的影響。管理層監察借款的              in cash flows. Management monitors the utilisation of borrowings and
      使用情況並確保遵守貸款契諾。                  ensures compliance with loan covenants.


      本集團依賴銀行及其他借款、優先票據、              The Group relies on bank and other borrowings, senior notes, corporate
      公司債務工具、證券化安排的收款及應付              debt instruments, receipts under securitisation arrangements and
      關聯人士款項作為重要的流動資金來源。              amounts due to related parties as a significant source of liquidity.


      鑒於本集團的供應商融資安排，相關貿易              Due to the Group’s supplier finance arrangements, the relevant trade
      應付款項乃支付予單一交易方而非個別供              payables are due to a single counterparty rather than individual suppliers.
      應商。這導致本集團需要與單一交易方結              This results in the Group being required to settle a significant amount with
      算大額金額，而非與多家供應商結算較小              a single counterparty, rather than less significant amounts with a number
      金額。然而，本集團就該等安排所涵蓋的              of suppliers. However, the Group’s payment terms for trade payables
      貿易應付款項的付款期與其他貿易應付款              covered by the arrangements are either identical to the payment terms for
      項的付款期相同，或延長至2年以內。鑒              other trade payables or extended to not more than 2 years. Management
      於付款期並無大幅延長，管理層認為供應              does not consider the supplier finance arrangements to result in
      商融資安排不會導致流動資金風險過度集              excessive concentrations of liquidity risk given the payment terms are not
      中。有關安排的詳情於財務報表附註30披             significantly extended. Details of the arrangements are disclosed in note
      露。                              30 to the financial statements.
